## About
Garage Motorsports is a transmission and hot rod shop on McLoughlin Blvd in Vancouver. We rebuild foreign and domestic manual gearboxes, keep remanufactured and new transmissions on hand, and sell new and used parts to go with them.
We are an Elite Dealer for Tremec, and we run a full service machine shop for stock or custom racing needs. Custom fabrication, motor swaps and hot rod and street rod restoration happen here too.
One reviewer called us a great old school shop. Customers mention Scott by name and say he knows a lot about cars and manual transmissions specifically. We hold a 4.7 rating from 29 Google reviews.

## Services
- 4, 5 & 6 Speed manual Rebuilds: Foreign and domestic manual transmissions rebuilt in the shop.
- Remanufactured & new transmissions: A selection of quality remanufactured and new Muncie transmissions and more, plus new and used parts.
- Tremec 5 & 6 speed Transmissions: Garage Motorsports is an Elite Dealer for Tremec 5 & 6 speed Transmissions.
- Machine Shop: Full service machine shop for stock or custom racing needs, from light to heavy.
- Transmission Rebuild Parts: Parts for rebuilding manual transmissions.
- Hot rod & street rod restoration: Custom restoration work on hot rods and street rods.
- Custom Fabrication: Custom fabricated parts and work for your build.
- Motor Swaps: Engine swaps for your project car.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What payment do you take?
A: PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, checks and cash.

Q: Can I email the shop?
A: Yes. Email Scott at scott@garagemotorsports.com.
